gaps.remaining: These privileged operations moved to admin-ts and are intentionally not deep-linked from the customer shell; validate mobile Admin coverage and retirement redirects before closure.

gaps.title: Payment callback, generic webview and membership/payment history
gaps.remaining: Payment is consolidated into checkout/order detail/membership screens, but provider callbacks and historical deep links require real H5/mini-program E2E. The unrestricted legacy webview remains retired pending an allowlist design.

gaps.title: Feedback, enterprise work mode and behalf ordering
gaps.remaining: work.ts has context APIs but no registered UI consumer; feedback and behalf ordering have neither registered routes nor complete target flows.

gaps.title: Community topic, search and video deep links
gaps.remaining: Feed, publish, detail modal and social relationships exist, but these three query-addressable screens do not yet have equivalent deep-link state.
